The shoot day is the short part. Enter the package price and every hour you spend: shoot, travel, the highlight film, the full ceremony and speeches edits, and revision rounds. What this does not cover

  • USD only. No currency conversion, income tax, self-employment tax or sales tax.
  • No market data. Example presets are unverified approximations, not surveys of what videographers charge.
  • Overhead beyond gear. Marketing, studio rent, accounting and unpaid inquiry time are not modelled; fold them into gear and insurance per year or into planning hours.

Common questions

How many hours does a wedding video really take?

The shoot is the short part. A highlight film often takes as many edit hours as the whole day took to film, and a full ceremony or speeches edit adds more, so total hours worked are commonly two to four times the shoot hours. Enter your own numbers: this calculator counts shoot, travel, planning, every edit and every revision round.

What hourly rate should a wedding videographer aim for?

That is your decision. Enter a target hourly rate and the calculator shows the minimum package price that reaches it for the hours and costs you entered, and how many edit hours the booking can absorb before it falls to that rate.

How many revision rounds should a package include?

Many videographers cap included revisions at one or two and charge a fee for extra rounds, because each round costs real editing hours. Set your cap, the rounds a client actually used and a fee per extra round to see how much revision creep costs.

Are the example numbers current market rates?

No. They are unverified approximations for illustration only, not survey data. Replace every figure with your own prices, hours and costs before relying on the result.

Is this financial advice?

No. It does arithmetic on the numbers you enter. It is not legal, tax or financial advice, and it does not cover income tax, sales tax or contract terms.

We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record — nothing you enter is saved anywhere by this tool.

Everything runs in your browser. Your numbers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (profit_calculated, example_loaded, tier_added) are counted only in local storage on your device. The counts can be deleted with the button below. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured.
